subject: Winthrop Street Parking and Bike Lane Petitions
overview: The commission denied resident requests to restore on-street parking on Winthrop Street, maintaining bicycle lanes installed during recent road restoration. The body also approved safety-related parking restrictions at two intersections to improve pedestrian visibility and sightlines.

items.title: Winthrop Street Parking Petitions (2023-34, 2023-37)
items.summary: Placed on file petitions from residents to remove 'no parking' signs and restore street parking between the Winchester line and Lawrence Road. Commissioners upheld existing bike lane regulations, citing state laws prohibiting parking in bike lanes and city policies prioritizing complete streets, despite resident concerns regarding visitor parking and safety crossing the roadway.

items.title: Daylighting Medford Street at Broadway (2023-38)
items.summary: Approved a 25-foot parking restriction on Medford Street at the Somerville city line to improve visibility at the crosswalk. The change formalizes existing parking behavior near an unsignalized portion of the intersection.

items.title: Salem Street and Fulton Street Parking Changes (2023-39)
items.summary: Approved extending parking restrictions and adding pavement hatching to improve sightlines at the intersection of Salem and Fulton Streets. The measure addresses a history of pedestrian collisions at the location by preventing vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk.

items.title: Parking Change Petition (2023-33)
items.summary: Tabled the matter to the October meeting because the petitioner was not present.
